label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The actual bug isn't in src/export/csv.ts — the CSV writer isn't merging rows. The culprit is the dedupe key in src/ingest/dedupe.ts, which is built from `[t.date, t.amount, t.description].join("|")` and doesn't include currency. Since 3.2.0 introduced per-transaction currency, two transactions that share date, amount and description but differ only in currency (e.g. one EUR, one USD) now collide on the same dedupe key, so one is dropped as a duplicate before it ever reaches the CSV export. The fix should add currency to `dedupeKey` (and update `keysFor`/tests accordingly).
